metaDescription: Plans from $10/month for salons, barbershops, and spas worldwide. Automated WhatsApp reminders, no card, no contract. Try it free for 7 days.

basico.description: 24/7 online booking, visual calendar, services and staff management, client database, commissions, loyalty program, custom subdomain.

esencial.description: Everything in Basic plus WhatsApp reminders from your own number, automated reminders, and a confirm/cancel link for clients.

marca.description: Everything in Essential plus a custom domain, 2 automated reminders, and bulk WhatsApp campaigns.

faq.q: Is there a contract or cancellation fee?
faq.a: No. It's month-to-month and you can cancel anytime with no penalties or contract clauses.

faq.q: Do reminders come from my own WhatsApp number?
faq.a: Yes. On plans that include WhatsApp, messages are sent from your official WhatsApp Business number.

faq.q: Is there a limit on bookings or staff?
faq.a: No. Unlimited bookings and appointments are included. You can also manage staff, schedules, and commissions.

faq.q: Does it include a website / landing page?
faq.a: Yes. A welcome landing page is included. On Own Brand it's more polished and runs on your own domain.

faq.q: Are there installation or setup fees?
faq.a: No. Everything is included in the monthly plan. No hidden costs.

faq.q: How do I pay for my AgenditApp subscription?
faq.a: We accept major credit and debit cards, plus bank transfer.

faq.q: Can I charge my clients for their bookings?
faq.a: Yes. From the Basic plan onward you can charge a deposit or the full booking amount by card, or accept a bank transfer receipt with no fee. The same methods work for in-house charges, like sales from your online store.

faq.q: Can I sell session packages, like a 4-session massage pack?
faq.a: Yes — on the Own Brand plan you can create prepaid session packages, and the system automatically deducts a session each time your client uses one.
